We're finalising the DPIA for our integration with Redwood and need to collect evidence for our legal and security teams. Can you provide the following:

Emma / team —

Thanks for the checklist. A couple points from Legal / Privacy so expectations are aligned:

1) Art.30 ledger: we can provide an export that includes processing purpose, categories of data, recipients, and transfer mechanisms. We cannot disclose internal customer IDs for other customers; the extract will only include Acme-related entries and aggregated recipient identifiers where applicable.

2) Subprocessor list: we will include names, locations, processing type, and onboarding effective date. For some infra partners we use partner-level groupings rather than individual hostnames; we will flag those rows.

3) SOC2: we will attach our SOC2+ISO27001 summary and a scan of the seal. Full reports are shared under executed NDAs or SOC2 access agreements — willing to initiate that process if needed.

4) Transfer mechanisms: for EU transfers we use SCCs where required; we will mark those subprocessors and provide references to the contractual clauses.

Action items and owners:
- Marissa: prepare processing map + Art.30 export + subprocessor CSV (target Mon 20 Apr).
- Kimberly: pull SOC2 summary and coordinate NDA language if Acme needs the full report.
- Vivek: confirm final delivery channel (secure Drive / SFTP) and whether Acme requires signed Data Access Appendix.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Note: if Acme prefers a formal questionnaire response (e.g., ISMS / Data Map), we can convert the materials into that format on request.
